add_definitions(-D__WINESRC__)
include_directories(${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/wine)
spec2def(mcicda.dll mcicda.spec)

# mcicda.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mcicda-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(mcicda_shims OBJECT mcicda.c)
target_link_libraries(mcicda_shims PRIVATE wine libwinmm libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libkernel32_vista libntdll)
add_cargo_module(mcicda mcicda-cargo mcicda.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mcicda_shims psdk)
